**The fix** (`src/price.js`): `applyDiscount` was subtracting the percent value directly (`paise - percent`). It now computes the discount as a percentage of the price, rounded down to the paise:

```js
export function applyDiscount(paise, percent) {
  const discount = Math.floor((paise * percent) / 100)
  return paise - discount
}
```

This makes `10000 @ 15% → 8500`, `999 @ 10% → 900` (99.9 paise discount floors to 99), and `500 @ 0% → 500`.
